parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

💡
admonish[ædmɑniʃ]v.
To admonish someone is to tell them you disapprove of their behavior.
→ The teacher admonished Mark because he was chewing gum in class.
💡
audible[ɔ:dəbl]adj.
If something is audible, then it is able to be heard.
→ The sound of the drums was audible from miles away.
💡
awesome[ɔ:səm]adj.
If something or someone is awesome, they are impressive or frightening.
→ The huge military plane was an awesome sight.
💡
beware[biwɛər]v.
To beware means to be careful of something or someone that is dangerous.
→ You should beware of driving fast on wet roads.
💡
brag[bræg]v.
To brag means to talk of one's abilities or achievements in a proud way.
→ He had strong muscles and bragged about it to the entire class.
💡
conscious[kɑnʃəs]adj.
If someone is conscious of something, then they are aware of it.
→ The new student was conscious of the other students staring at her.
💡
disagree[disəgri:]v.
To disagree with someone means to have a different opinion from them.
→ The lawyers disagreed about the best way to settle the case.
💡
echo[ekou]v.
To echo means that a sound repeats itself because it bounced off an object.
→ The child yelled over the canyon, and the wall echoed the sound.
💡
eventual[iventʃuəl]adj.
If something is eventual, it will happen at the end of a series of events.
→ The constant training and planning led the team to an eventual victory.
💡
hint[hint]n.
A hint is information that suggests something will happen or is true.
→ I quietly passed on a hint to my sister about the test.
💡
idiot[idiət]n.
An idiot is a person who is not smart or who has done something silly.
→ Because he got lost in the forest, the man felt like an idiot.
💡
immense[imens]adj.
If something is immense, it is very large.
→ An immense amount of money was needed to buy such a large boat.
💡
indirect[indirekt]adj.
If something is indirect, then it is not the easiest or straightest way.
→ He chose to take the most indirect route to the coast.
💡
option[ɑpʃən]n.
An option is a choice between two or more things.
→ The children were given the option of three houses to pick from.
💡
pastime[pæstaim]n.
A pastime is an activity done for fun that you do often.
→ In the US, baseball is considered the national pastime.
💡
perfect[pə:rfikt]adj.
If something is perfect, then it is without any mistakes.
→ She got all the questions right, so her score was perfect.
💡
pinpoint[pinpɔint]v.
To pinpoint something means to locate it exactly.
→ The navigation system in my car is able to pinpoint my exact location.
💡
switch[switʃ]v.
To switch means to change something to something else.
→ Mom switched the TV station from the news to her favorite show.
💡
thorough[θə:rou]adj.
If something or someone is thorough, then they are complete in everyway.
→ Tina did a thorough job of cleaning the stains out of the carpet.
💡
torment[tɔ:rment]v.
To torment someone means to cause them to suffer on purpose.
→ She tormented her little brother by taking his favorite toy.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. I had the ___________ of going with them or staying home. I felt like an __________ for the choice I made.
options: idiot / option
option / idiot
option / immense
immense / idiot
questions.explanation: option (lựa chọn) phù hợp với vế 1, idiot (kẻ ngốc) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 2. Because he liked to ___________ the kitten by pouring water on it, the boy's mother ___________ him for his cruel behavior.
options: admonished / torment
torment / perfect
torment / admonished
admonished / brag
questions.explanation: torment (hành hạ) phù hợp với vế 1, admonished (khiển trách) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 3. It was difficult to ___________ the dog's location because its cries ___________ off of the hills.
options: echoed / pinpoint
pinpoint / echoed
pinpoint / switch
switch / echoed
questions.explanation: pinpoint (xác định chính xác) phù hợp với vế 1, echoed (vang dội) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 4. My sister likes to ___________ about how my mother and father think her behavior is ___________.
options: brag / perfect
perfect / brag
perfect / eventual
brag / eventual
questions.explanation: brag (khoác lác) phù hợp với vế 1, perfect (hoàn hảo) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 5. When you ___________ the machine on, you need to ___________ because the machine is dangerous.
options: beware / switch
switch / beware
switch / conscious
conscious / beware
questions.explanation: switch (bật/tắt) phù hợp với vế 1, beware (cẩn thận) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 6. All of the accidents at the swimming pool led to the __________ closing of it and the end of a favorite summer __________.
options: eventual / pastime
pastime / eventual
pastime / awesome
eventual / awesome
questions.explanation: eventual (cuối cùng) phù hợp với vế 1, pastime (thú vui) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 7. The king wanted people to think that his power was __________ . He would put people in jail if they ___________ with him.
options: disagreed / awesome
awesome / disagreed
awesome / immense
disagreed / immense
questions.explanation: awesome (đáng kinh ngạc/đáng sợ) phù hợp với vế 1, disagreed (không đồng ý) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 8. Even though the little girl was trying to sneak up on her parents, her __________ steps made her parents ___________ of her.
options: audible / conscious
conscious / audible
audible / thorough
conscious / thorough
questions.explanation: audible (có thể nghe thấy) phù hợp với vế 1, conscious (nhận thức) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 9. An ___________ tree fell across the road, forcing the travelers to take a more __________ route through the countryside.
options: indirect / immense
immense / indirect
immense / perfect
indirect / perfect
questions.explanation: immense (rất lớn) phù hợp với vế 1, indirect (gián tiếp/vòng vèo) phù hợp với vế 2.

questions.content: 10. The police could not find a single clue to the crime, which gave a ___________ as to how ___________ the thief had been.
options: hint / thorough
thorough / hint
hint / option
thorough / option
questions.explanation: hint (gợi ý) phù hợp với vế 1, thorough (kỹ lưỡng) phù hợp với vế 2.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Part A Match the phrases to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. You should beware
options: a. about which game was better
b. of the hole in the bridge
c. for talking during the test
d. was the reason for the bad smell
questions.explanation: beware of (cẩn thận với) phù hợp với 'the hole in the bridge'.

questions.content: 2. My favorite pastime
options: a. took an hour more to drive
b. fear that his home would be damaged
c. from her left hand to her right
d. is listening to music
questions.explanation: pastime (thú vui) phù hợp với 'listening to music'.

questions.content: 3. The doctor did a thorough check
options: a. about how good she is at sports
b. of the sick man's health
c. took an hour more to drive
d. fear that his home would be damaged
questions.explanation: thorough check (kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng) phù hợp với sức khỏe của bệnh nhân.

questions.content: 4. The two friends disagreed
options: a. about which game was better
b. of the hole in the bridge
c. for talking during the test
d. was the reason for the bad smell
questions.explanation: disagreed about (không đồng tình về) phù hợp với việc trò chơi nào tốt hơn.

questions.content: 5. She switched the bag
options: a. took an hour more to drive
b. fear that his home would be damaged
c. from her left hand to her right
d. is listening to music
questions.explanation: switched (chuyển đổi) từ tay trái sang tay phải.

questions.content: 6. His proud sister brags
options: a. about how good she is at sports
b. of the sick man's health
c. took an hour more to drive
d. fear that his home would be damaged
questions.explanation: brags about (khoe khoang về) khả năng chơi thể thao.

questions.content: 7. An immense pile of garbage
options: a. about which game was better
b. of the hole in the bridge
c. for talking during the test
d. was the reason for the bad smell
questions.explanation: immense pile of garbage (đống rác khổng lồ) là nguyên nhân gây mùi hôi.

questions.content: 8. The indirect route
options: a. about how good she is at sports
b. of the sick man's health
c. took an hour more to drive
d. fear that his home would be damaged
questions.explanation: indirect route (đường vòng) mất thêm một giờ lái xe.

questions.content: 9. The awesome storm caused
options: a. about how good she is at sports
b. of the sick man's health
c. took an hour more to drive
d. fear that his home would be damaged
questions.explanation: awesome storm (cơn bão đáng sợ) gây ra nỗi sợ hãi.

questions.content: 10. She admonished the student
options: a. about which game was better
b. of the hole in the bridge
c. for talking during the test
d. was the reason for the bad smell
questions.explanation: admonished (khiển trách) học sinh vì nói chuyện trong giờ kiểm tra.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Part B Match the clauses to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. He couldn't sleep at night
options: a. if they wanted to get a perfect grade
b. but he was conscious of the other boats
c. because bad dreams tormented him
d. then people might think you're an idiot
questions.explanation: bad dreams tormented him (những giấc mơ xấu hành hạ anh ta) khiến anh ta không thể ngủ.

questions.content: 2. We knew he broke his leg when he fell
options: a. but it was just the echo of her voice
b. because there weren't any other options
c. so he could pinpoint his location in the wild
d. because the sound of the bone breaking was audible
questions.explanation: sound of the bone breaking was audible (tiếng gãy xương có thể nghe rõ).

questions.content: 3. He had to choose the blue car
options: a. but it was just the echo of her voice
b. because there weren't any other options
c. so he could pinpoint his location in the wild
d. because the sound of the bone breaking was audible
questions.explanation: there weren't any other options (không còn lựa chọn nào khác).

questions.content: 4. The hiker always carried a compass and map,
options: a. but it was just the echo of her voice
b. because there weren't any other options
c. so he could pinpoint his location in the wild
d. because the sound of the bone breaking was audible
questions.explanation: pinpoint his location (xác định vị trí chính xác) bằng la bàn và bản đồ.

questions.content: 5. She didn't eat good food and didn't exercise,
options: a. and it led to her eventual illness
b. because they gave him so many hints
c. if they wanted to get a perfect grade
d. but he was conscious of the other boats
questions.explanation: led to her eventual illness (dẫn đến căn bệnh cuối cùng của cô ấy) do thói quen xấu.

questions.content: 6. The students had to answer all the questions correctly
options: a. and it led to her eventual illness
b. because they gave him so many hints
c. if they wanted to get a perfect grade
d. but he was conscious of the other boats
questions.explanation: get a perfect grade (đạt điểm hoàn hảo) nếu trả lời đúng tất cả.

questions.content: 7. The captain did not see the ship approaching behind him,
options: a. and it led to her eventual illness
b. because they gave him so many hints
c. if they wanted to get a perfect grade
d. but he was conscious of the other boats
questions.explanation: conscious of the other boats (nhận thức được các thuyền khác).

questions.content: 8. She thought someone was calling to her from the other cliff,
options: a. because bad dreams tormented him
b. then people might think you're an idiot
c. but it was just the echo of her voice
d. because there weren't any other options
questions.explanation: echo of her voice (tiếng vang giọng nói của cô ấy).

questions.content: 9. He knew his friends were having a surprise party for him
options: a. and it led to her eventual illness
b. because they gave him so many hints
c. if they wanted to get a perfect grade
d. but he was conscious of the other boats
questions.explanation: gave him so many hints (đã cho anh ta quá nhiều gợi ý).

questions.content: 10. If you can't tie your own shoes by the time you're twelve years old
options: a. because bad dreams tormented him
b. then people might think you're an idiot
c. but it was just the echo of her voice
d. because there weren't any other options
questions.explanation: people might think you're an idiot (mọi người có thể nghĩ bạn là kẻ ngốc).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Young Man and the Old Man

A proud young man was looking for a new pastime. He heard about people hiking in the national parks and decided to try it for himself. As he started his stroll, an old man walked up to him.

"Don't go this way," the old man said. "Beware. The paths are not clear. It's easy to become lost."

But the young man disagreed with the old man and bragged that he had a perfect understanding of the park. "I studied maps of this area," he told him. "I believe I have a thorough knowledge of these trails. I won't become lost."

The old man listened to the young man and then admonished him for his pride.

"I have walked these trails my entire life," he said. "If you think you will be safe, then go ahead."

The young man ignored the old man and started along the trail.

Whenever he had to choose between an easy or difficult route, he always chose the more difficult option. In addition, he was not conscious of which direction he was going. After a while, he decided to return home. Because his course through the wilderness was so indirect, he had no idea where he was.

He looked at his map but could not pinpoint his location. He walked one path after another but soon realized he was lost.

The sun was going down, and sudden strong winds gave a hint that it might rain. Immense clouds filled the sky. Awesome sounds of thunder were audible from all directions. It echoed off the mountains. The thought of the eventual storm tormented the young man. He hurried in one direction, but soon switched out of confusion. Luckily, it led him out of the park.

When he arrived home, he knew that he had acted like an idiot. He realized he was lucky to be alive. He decided to listen to people with more experience than himself.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension: Part A
sections.content: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. The young man decided to hike in the national parks.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: True. He heard about people hiking in the national parks and decided to try it for himself.

questions.content: 2. The young man disagreed with the old man.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: True. The young man disagreed with the old man and bragged that he had a perfect understanding of the park.

questions.content: 3. The young man believed that his knowledge of the park's trails was thorough.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: True. He told the old man: 'I believe I have a thorough knowledge of these trails.'

questions.content: 4. When the young man had an option of two trails, he always chose the easier one.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: False. Whenever he had to choose between an easy or difficult route, he always chose the more difficult option.

questions.content: 5. The young man was tormented by the thought of the eventual storm.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: True. The thought of the eventual storm tormented the young man.

questions.content: 6. When the young man got home, he knew that the old man had acted like an idiot.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: False. When he arrived home, he knew that he had acted like an idiot (không phải là ông lão).

questions.content: 1. What did the young man choose as his new pastime?
options: a. Picking trails
b. Climbing mountains
c. Talking with old men
d. Hiking in parks
questions.explanation: A proud young man was looking for a new pastime. He heard about people hiking in the national parks and decided to try it for himself.

questions.content: 2. Why did the old man admonish the young man?
options: a. The young man was awesome.
b. The young man bragged that he was perfect.
c. The young man's route was too indirect.
d. The young man chose difficult trails.
questions.explanation: The young man bragged that he had a perfect understanding of the park, so the old man admonished him for his pride.

questions.content: 3. Why did the young man become lost?
options: a. He was not conscious of where he went.
b. He pinpointed his location on his map.
c. He did not switch to an easier trail.
d. He listened to the old man's advice.
questions.explanation: In addition, he was not conscious of which direction he was going. Because his course was so indirect, he had no idea where he was.

questions.content: 4. Which of the following gave a hint of an eventual storm?
options: a. The sudden strong winds
b. The sparse clouds in the sky
c. The weather getting colder
d. The lightining flashing in the sky
questions.explanation: The sun was going down, and sudden strong winds gave a hint that it might rain.
